The '''Hollow Mountains''' were a mountain range that ran alongside the capital city [[Unparala]] on the planet [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]]. The interior of the mountains was riddled with tunnels and caverns, some created naturally and others formed by the [[borecrawler]] insectiles. Virjuansi natives also created caverns for use as living space. The Hollow Mountains were named for the hollowness of their interior.
